problem.subtitleP1: An agency client's retention hinges above all on
problem.subtitleP2: . You deliver excellent work - but if it stays invisible, the client eventually wonders what their budget is for.

cards.title: Time-consuming
cards.description: One clear update per client, every week. Multiply by 15 clients: that's a half-day gone.

cards.title: Neglected
cards.description: Under pressure, the update gets skipped. A few quiet weeks and the relationship cools without a sound.

cards.title: Churn
cards.description: "Nothing's happening." The client questions the budget, compares, then leaves - even though the work was good.

process.heading: From your tasks to a sent update, in three steps.
process.subtitle: You keep editorial control. Rekap writes the draft - you approve it.

steps.title: Connect your tool
steps.text: Link Asana in two clicks and pick each client's projects. Asana first, ClickUp & monday next.

steps.title: Rekap writes the draft
steps.text: At your chosen cadence, the AI turns completed tasks into a business-value narrative - in your tone, in the client's language.

steps.title: Review & send
steps.text: Edit inline, approve, send. The email goes out on-brand, from your address. Every update is archived.
